name: Aoi Ko Tsukamaeta
source:
Cute looks, refreshing eyes. Gazing calming. A vision of gentle, sweet purity.

The bishoujo that captivated my heart. I loved her for so long.

One day she talked to me. It was my chance.

I managed to invite her to visit my home and then restrained both her arms.

How shocked and confused those eyes became. I had my way with her. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098841.html]DLsite English[/url]]
